limitations: This is a retrospectively reconstructed pilot manifest, not an original run manifest.
Each candidate was evaluated once, so optimizer selection may retain scheduler-cadence and timestamp noise.
The nominal four-weight policy representation contains scale invariance and a Packing dependency under homogeneous workers.
The exact command, working-tree state, Kubernetes version, kind version, node image, and Go runtime version were not persisted.
The metric named maxActiveNodes counts worker nodes hosting non-terminal evaluator Pods; it does not measure powered or autoscaled nodes.
